info.title: Znode Tax Manager API V1
info.description: Tax Manager APIs for calculating, committing, cancelling, and returning order tax transactions.

post.description:
Calculate taxes for cart items. Supports third-party tax plugins (e.g., AvaTax), built-in Sales Tax, and tax-exempt modes that return zero tax when the order qualifies for tax exemption.

Requires plugin configurations, tax bag settings, and cart data including items, addresses, and tax flags.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Cancel the tax transaction for a previously committed order.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/177913dd38164-cancel-order)
- **`POST`** [Commit tax transaction to the tax provider.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/07eb784bdac1b-commit-tax-to-the-portal)

200.description: **OK** - Tax calculation completed successfully. The response body contains the calculated tax amounts for each cart item, including line-level and total tax values based on the configured tax plugin.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully executed, but no tax calculation results were returned for the provided cart items.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request could not be processed due to invalid input, missing required fields, or malformed syntax. Verify the request parameters and body.

value.errorMessage: The request contains invalid data. Verify the pluginGlobalConfigurations, pluginConfigurationSet, and pluginTaxCart fields.

401.description: **Unauthorized** - The request failed because the Authorization header is missing or the token/API key is invalid or expired.

value.errorMessage: Authorization failed. Invalid or missing credentials.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

value.errorMessage: An unexpected error occurred while processing the tax calculation request.

post.description:
Cancel the tax transaction for a previously committed order. Sends a cancellation request to the configured tax provider to void or reverse the tax record.

Requires the order number, cart items, and plugin configuration to process the cancellation.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Calculate taxes for cart items.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/749875ddedead-calculate-taxes-for-cart-items)
- **`POST`** [Commit tax transaction to the tax provider.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/07eb784bdac1b-commit-tax-to-the-portal)
- **`POST`** [Process a return for order line items.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/8bf4b90b2dbbf-return-order-line-item)

200.description: **OK** - Tax transaction cancellation completed successfully. The response body confirms the cancellation request was sent to the tax provider and the tax record for the specified order has been voided or reversed.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully executed, but no content was returned after processing the order cancellation.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request could not be processed due to invalid input, missing required fields, or malformed syntax. Verify the request parameters and body.

value.errorMessage: The request contains invalid data. Verify the orderNumber, cartItems, and pluginGlobalConfigurations fields.

401.description: **Unauthorized** - The request failed because the Authorization header is missing or the token/API key is invalid or expired.

value.errorMessage: Authorization failed. Invalid or missing credentials.

404.description: **Not Found** - The requested resource could not be found. Verify the identifiers in the request.

value.errorMessage: The order was not found. Verify the order number provided.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

value.errorMessage: An unexpected error occurred while cancelling the tax transaction.

post.description:
Commit (submit) a tax transaction to the tax provider. Finalizes the tax record for the order so the tax provider can include it in reporting and remittance.

Requires plugin configuration, the tax cart with order and address details, and the plugin URL.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Calculate taxes for cart items.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/749875ddedead-calculate-taxes-for-cart-items)
- **`POST`** [Cancel the tax transaction for a previously committed order.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/177913dd38164-cancel-order)
- **`POST`** [Perform pre-submit order process validation.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/tax-manager-api-v1--internal/branches/main/30cc06e176fe3-pre-submit-order-process)

200.description: **OK** - Tax transaction committed successfully. The response body confirms the tax record has been finalized with the tax provider and is included in reporting and remittance.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully executed, but no content was returned after committing the tax to the portal.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request could not be processed due to invalid input, missing required fields, or malformed syntax. Verify the request parameters and body.

value.errorMessage: The request contains invalid data. Verify the pluginGlobalConfigurations, pluginConfigurationSet, pluginTaxCart, and pluginUrl fields.

401.description: **Unauthorized** - The request failed because the Authorization header is missing or the token/API key is invalid or expired.

value.errorMessage: Authorization failed. Invalid or missing credentials.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

value.errorMessage: An unexpected error occurred while committing the tax transaction.

post.description:

Use this endpoint to verify order details are correct before calling the submit endpoint.

---

post.description:
Process a return for order line items. Sends return and refund details to the configured tax provider to adjust the tax transaction for the specified order.

Requires the order number, items being returned, tax override amounts, and plugin configuration.

---

pluginGlobalConfigurations.description:

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Plugin List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Plugin/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to System Settings > Plugin > Edit Plugin > Global Configuration
2. View the configuration fields

isHandlingChargeTaxable.description:
Indicates whether handling charges are included in the taxable shipping amount.

- If `isCalculateTaxOnShipping` and `isHandlingChargeTaxable` are both `true`, the shipping line includes both the shipping cost and handling charge.
- If only `isHandlingChargeTaxable` is `true`, the shipping line includes only the handling charge.
- If only `isCalculateTaxOnShipping` is `true`, the shipping line includes only the shipping cost.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Tax Class List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/TaxClass/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to System Settings > Taxes
2. Edit or Manage Tax > Tax Rule List
4. Edit a Tax Rule > Edit Tax Type
5. Check "Include Handling Charge in Taxes" > this is isHandlingChargeTaxable

**Knowledgebase:** [Adding A Tax Rule](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757198-adding-a-tax-rule)
